sources.label: Wikipedia, "Pherkad"
sources.quote: Pherkad, Bayer designation Gamma Ursae Minoris, is a star in the northern constellation of Ursa Minor.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 998 times the Sun's luminosity at 8,015 K, so 16.408 solar radii.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Pherkad"
sources.quote: Together with Beta Ursae Minoris (Kochab), it forms the end of the dipper pan of the "Little Dipper", which is an asterism forming the tail of the bear.
